title: artifact-share-metadata/v1
description: Owned YAML frontmatter on content/shares/<hash>.mdx. Version 1 also accepts an absent identifier. Historical plain hash scalars match the complete 12-character lowercase hexadecimal grammar. When YAML interprets them as numbers, readers recover their original text, including leading zeros and exponent-shaped hashes, never reconstructing identity from the number. Body, component props, unknown frontmatter, and original asset bytes are authored content; historical publications have no automatic upgrade. The CLI, checks:types and actual MDX schema boundary share this lossless historical interpretation.
